hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; M="$HOME/.local/bin/mise"; [ -x "$M" ] || curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$M" trust -q . && "$M" install -q && { [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo "eval \"\$('$M' env -s bash -C '$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR')\"" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; } && "$M" exec -- node --version
